audit_status.review_note: Divine glory, nations, idol polemic, trust, priesthood, blessing, and life/death.

verses.restored: Not to us, YHWH, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your steadfast love and faithfulness.

familiar.text: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth’s sake.

modern.text: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.

original.text: לֹ֤א לָ֥נוּ יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֫א לָ֥נוּ כִּֽי לְ֭שִׁמְךָ תֵּ֣ן כָּב֑וֹד עַל חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ עַל אֲמִתֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is now their God?

familiar.text: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?

modern.text: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”

original.text: לָ֭מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אַיֵּה נָ֝֗א אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

familiar.text: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

modern.text: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.

original.text: וֵֽאלֹהֵ֥ינוּ בַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר חָפֵ֣ץ עָשָֽׂה

verses.restored: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.

familiar.text: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

notes.title: Idol polemic
notes.body: The psalm’s satire of manufactured images belongs to ancient Israelite religious polemic. It must not be used to demean, vandalize, or persecute modern religious communities or sacred art.

modern.text: Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

original.text: עֲֽ֭צַבֵּיהֶם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם

verses.restored: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

familiar.text: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

modern.text: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;

original.text: פֶּֽה לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ

verses.restored: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

familiar.text: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

modern.text: they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;

original.text: אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ אַ֥ף לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יְרִיחֽוּן

verses.restored: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

familiar.text: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

modern.text: they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats.

original.text: יְדֵיהֶ֤ם וְלֹ֬א יְמִישׁ֗וּן רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם וְלֹ֣א יְהַלֵּ֑כוּ לֹֽא יֶ֝הְגּ֗וּ בִּגְרוֹנָֽם

verses.restored: They that make them are like to them; so is every one that trusteth in them.

familiar.text: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.

modern.text: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.

original.text: כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם

verses.restored: O Israel, trust thou in YHWH: he is their help and their shield.

familiar.text: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

modern.text: O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

original.text: יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בְּטַ֣ח בַּיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא

verses.restored: O house of Aaron, trust in YHWH: he is their help and their shield.

familiar.text: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

modern.text: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

original.text: בֵּ֣ית אַ֭הֲרֹן בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא

verses.restored: Ye that fear YHWH, trust in YHWH: he is their help and their shield.

familiar.text: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

modern.text: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

original.text: יִרְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא

verses.restored: YHWH hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

familiar.text: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

modern.text: The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;

original.text: יְהוָה֮ זְכָרָ֪נוּ יְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ יְ֭בָרֵךְ אֶת בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְ֝בָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת בֵּ֥ית אַהֲרֹֽן

verses.restored: He will bless them that fear YHWH, both small and great.

familiar.text: He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.

modern.text: He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.

original.text: יְ֭בָרֵךְ יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝קְּטַנִּ֗ים עִם הַגְּדֹלִֽים

verses.restored: YHWH shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

familiar.text: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

modern.text: May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.

original.text: יֹסֵ֣ף יְהוָ֣ה עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם וְעַל בְּנֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Ye are blessed of YHWH which made heaven and earth.

familiar.text: Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.

modern.text: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

original.text: בְּרוּכִ֣ים אַ֭תֶּם לַיהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: The heaven, even the heavens, are YHWH’s: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

familiar.text: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD’s: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

modern.text: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.

original.text: הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שָׁ֭מַיִם לַיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הָאָ֗רֶץ נָתַ֥ן לִבְנֵי אָדָֽם

verses.restored: The dead praise not YHWH, neither any that go down into silence.

familiar.text: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.

modern.text: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.

original.text: לֹ֣א הַ֭מֵּתִים יְהַֽלְלוּ יָ֑הּ וְ֝לֹ֗א כָּל יֹרְדֵ֥י דוּמָֽה

verses.restored: But we will bless YHWH from this time forth and for evermore. Praise YHWH.

familiar.text: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.

modern.text: But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore. Hallelujah!

original.text: וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ נְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ יָ֗הּ מֵֽעַתָּ֥ה וְעַד עוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
